title: NPV: 142 rows counted against a live oracle, and no catalogue row at all
status_plain: NPV appears in no row of the OxFunc discrepancy catalogue -- the G6 section has ten rows and none is NPV -- yet 142 NPV rows were probed directly against a live Excel oracle. The worksheet surface was probed twice: first 94 rows, where every one-flow row matched the division form exactly and the best three-flow form reached 79 of 94 with 15 rows left at 1 to 2 ULP; then a widened 142-row corpus where the kernel stalled at 106 and the lane pivoted to RATE. Both scores are candidate op-graphs racing against the oracle, not the shipped kernel's pass rate, and both corpora were built to fit the kernel, so neither is held out. A statement that NPV has no comparison record is false; a statement that NPV passed anything is equally false.
